entities.name: UniProt:A5CWF9
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (636 aa) identifies this as threonine-tRNA ligase (ThrRS), EC 6.1.1.3.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent attachment of L-threonine to tRNA(Thr); reference annotation also reports editing of mischarged seryl-tRNA(Thr).
Reference annotation: cytoplasmic, homodimeric, with one Zn2+ per subunit.
Sequence-derived estimates: 73.0 kDa, theoretical pI 8.49; Pfam matches tRNA_SAD, tRNA-synt_2b, and HGTP_anticodon.

entities.name: RHEA:24624
observations: L-threonine + ATP + tRNA(Thr) → threonyl-tRNA(Thr) + AMP + diphosphate + H+; catalyzed by threonine-tRNA ligase.
